i1.speaker: Guide
i1.npcText: Hi! For our first level, let's get to know you.

i2.speaker: Guide
i2.npcText: Hello, {name}! Your name in Sanskrit can be written as {sanskritName}.
i2.npcTranslation: Now, how would you introduce yourself?

choices.feedback: For a self-introduction, use “मम नाम ... अस्ति” to say “My name is ...”
The teacher asked about your homework, not playtime.

c2a.speaker: Teacher
c2a.npcTranslation: Excellent! Now show me the lesson.

choices.feedback: The teacher asked to see your homework, so you need to show it.
The teacher asked you to finish your homework before playing.

choices.choiceTranslation: Yes, I will finish the homework now.

p1.speaker: Friend
p1.npcTranslation: Are you coming to play this evening?

choices.choiceTranslation: Yes, I am bringing a ball.

choices.feedback: Your friend invited you this evening, but this reply moves the plan to tomorrow.

p2a.speaker: Friend
p2a.npcText: अस्तु! क्रीडाङ्गणम् आगच्छतु। अन्ये अपि आगच्छन्ति।
p2a.npcTranslation: Great! Come to the field. Others are coming too.

choices.choiceTranslation: I will bring my friend too.

choices.feedback: Your friend asked about meeting at the field, so respond to the plan instead of changing the topic.

choices.choiceTranslation: Yes, I will definitely come tomorrow.

choices.feedback: You agreed to meet tomorrow, so confirm that plan rather than return to playing today.

f1.speaker: Vendor
f1.npcTranslation: Hello! What would you like today?

choices.choiceTranslation: What is the price of mangoes?
choices.feedback: Asking the price is useful, but the vendor first asked what you would like.

f2a.speaker: Vendor
f2a.npcText: अस्तु, एकं किलोग्रामस्य मूल्यं अशीतिः रूप्यकाणि। किमपि अन्यत्?
f2a.npcTranslation: Okay, that will be 80 rupees. Anything else?

choices.choiceTranslation: I am going to the playground.
choices.feedback: The vendor asked whether you want anything else.

f2b.speaker: Vendor
f2b.npcText: एकं किलोग्रामस्य मूल्यं शतं रूप्यकाणि। बद्धं करोमि किम्?
f2b.npcTranslation: It is 100 rupees per kg. Should I pack it?

choices.feedback: The vendor asked whether to pack the mangoes first.

r1.speaker: Waiter
r1.npcTranslation: Hello. What would you like to eat?

choices.choiceTranslation: I would like a vegetarian meal.
Where is the price of the food?
choices.feedback: The waiter asked what you would like to eat.
Respond to the waiter about your food order.

r2.speaker: Waiter
r2.npcTranslation: Alright. What would you like to drink?

choices.feedback: The waiter asked what you would like to drink.
Choose a drink in response to the waiter.

r3.speaker: Waiter
r3.npcTranslation: You have finished your meal. Would you like anything else?

choices.choiceTranslation: No thank you. Please give me the bill.

choices.feedback: A restaurant conversation should end by responding about the order or bill.
This is possible, but asking for the bill best completes this conversation.

d1.speaker: Local
d1.npcTranslation: Hello. Where would you like to go?

choices.choiceTranslation: I would like to go to the railway station.

choices.feedback: First tell the person where you want to go.
The question is asking about your destination.

choices.choiceTranslation: I go straight and then turn right, correct?
I go straight and then turn left, correct?
choices.feedback: The direction given was right, not left.
Repeat the directions to confirm you understood them.

d3.speaker: Local
d3.npcText: आम्। ततः रेलस्थानकं भवतः वामभागे भविष्यति।
d3.npcTranslation: Yes. Then the railway station will be on your left.

choices.choiceTranslation: Thank you. Now I know the way.
No, I am going to a restaurant.
choices.feedback: You were asking for directions to the railway station.

choices.choiceTranslation: The railway station is on the right.
choices.feedback: The speaker said it will be on your left.

b1.speaker: Ticket Clerk
b1.npcTranslation: Hello. Where would you like to travel?

choices.choiceTranslation: I would like to go to Delhi.

choices.feedback: First tell the clerk your destination.

choices.choiceTranslation: My friend is going to Delhi.
choices.feedback: The clerk asked where you want to travel.

b2.speaker: Ticket Clerk
b2.npcTranslation: The bus to Delhi will leave at six in the evening.

choices.choiceTranslation: The bus leaves at six in the morning.
choices.feedback: The clerk said six in the evening.
You can continue by requesting a ticket for the announced bus.
The ticket costs 500 rupees, not 50.
Respond to the ticket price.

f1.speaker: Vendor
f1.npcTranslation: Hello! What would you like today?

choices.choiceTranslation: What is the price of mangoes?
choices.feedback: Asking the price is useful, but the vendor first asked what you would like.

f2a.npcTranslation: Okay, that will be 80 rupees. Anything else?

choices.choiceTranslation: I am going to the playground.
choices.feedback: The vendor asked whether you want anything else.

f2b.npcText: एकं किलोग्रामस्य मूल्यं शतं रूप्यकाणि। बद्धं करोमि किम्?
f2b.npcTranslation: It is 100 rupees per kg. Should I pack it?
